references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses about appointing cities of refuge, which is the original command that Joshua is now to carry out.
Moses gives instructions regarding cities of refuge in Deuteronomy, forming the basis for what the Lord commands Joshua.
The first mention of a place of refuge in the law, pointing forward to the system of cities of refuge.
The same expression is used at the beginning of the book of Joshua when the Lord speaks to Joshua after Moses' death.
The Lord commands that there shall be six cities of refuge, which are now to be fulfilled through Joshua.
